tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows markedly elevated NT-proBNP, suggestive of heart failure or significant cardiac strain. There is normocytic, hypochromic anemia with increased red cell distribution width, possibly indicating mixed or evolving anemia. Mild hypo-proteinemia is present. HbA1c is elevated, indicating suboptimal glycemic control. Renal, liver, and electrolyte parameters are within normal limits. Recommend clinical correlation for heart failure, anemia workup, and diabetes management.
